content: MK cites a letter from Akhlāṭī to Ṣāʾin al-Dīn preserved in MS Majlis 10196 in which the teacher addresses his disciple (khalīlī) as the leading luminary of his circle of brethren (wāsiṭat ʿaqd ikhwāni-hi); MK takes this as confirming that Ṣāʾin al-Dīn was regarded as leader of the Isfahan Circle, and notes ikhwān may allude to the Ikhwān al-Ṣafāʾ network (Binbaş).
refers_to_primary: Akhlāṭī's letter to Ibn Turka, MS Majlis 10196 (TMN/M front matter; MK Part 2 §P.2.2)
